reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.Assumption23.mk
Paper notion: the constructor of the Lean structure encoding Assumption 2.3 (see the reading of
Spec.Assumption23): from 0<=L, the interior diagonal Lipschitz bound for a.e. t and the terminal
Lipschitz bound with the same L, build the assumption.
Faithful iff its arguments are exactly the fields of a faithful Assumption23 (L>=0, LipInterior L,
LipTerminal L, with nothing extra and nothing missing).

comparison.text:
Comparison: constructor Spec.Assumption23.mk vs locked reading.
Arguments: 0 ≤ L, LipInterior ℱ P T L C, LipTerminal ℱ P T L C.g — exactly the fields of
Assumption23; returns Assumption23 ℱ P T L C. Nothing extra, nothing missing; meaning that of
Assumption23.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices (L a parameter, as for Assumption23).

verdict.detail:
Representation choice: the constant L is a parameter of the predicate (with the field 0 ≤ L)
rather than existentially quantified; the paper's Assumption 2.3 is ∃ L, Assumption23 ℱ P T L C,
and the statements that use it quantify L (constants then depend on that L, as in the paper).
The same L appears in the interior and the terminal parts, as printed.

author_review.disagreements:
No disagreement in substance. Classification only: the shown review records "faithful"; I record
"faithful with representation choices" for the same reason as for Assumption23 (L a parameter
of the predicate rather than existentially quantified); the constructor's arguments are exactly
the fields.
